tools.name: search
tools.description: Search every collection at once: Georgia General Assembly bills (every version) and amendments, Supreme Court of Georgia opinions, the Official Code of Georgia Annotated and the Georgia and U.S. constitutions, and machine transcripts of House and Senate meetings. Plain-language questions work: resul

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one document by id or any written form (bill:2025-2026/hb136, SB 3, opinion:S26A0060, 317 Ga. 528, code:16-11-127, O.C.G.A. § 16-11-127, ga-const:art-i-sec-i-para-iii, meeting:2026-02-05/house-rules, a page URL) as Markdown, at most `max_chars` (default 60,000) from `start`, with a pointer to t

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: What Georgia Commons holds, computed now: each source's documents by type and issuing body, date ranges, how much is searchable by meaning, the last update, the qualifications, and what is not held yet (local governments, school boards, the Court of Appeals). Filters narrow it.

tools.name: describe_site
tools.description: Orientation: what Georgia Commons is, the id grammar, the filter values, and the bodies. Call it first.

tools.name: verify_quote
tools.description: Check whether a quotation appears word for word in a stored document (or one version of it), after normalizing whitespace, typographic quotes and dashes, [T]he-style alterations, amendment marks, and case. Use it before relying on a quotation.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "describe_site" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "An overview of Georgia Commons: what it holds, which collections this server has loaded, how ids and page addresses are written, which tool fits which kind of question, and the independence statement. A short response." → after: "Orientation: what Georgia Commons is, the id grammar, the filter values, and the bodies. Call it first."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
